name: ComboboxItem
purpose: A selectable option row in a listbox where focus stays in a text field. Two contexts: palette rows inside CommandPalette (run a command, or jump to a list or project, with an optional trailing shortcut); and mention rows inside Popover (an attachment candidate). Merges A's ComboboxItem and B's CommandItem; the measured values of A are kept.
base: Palette: shadcn CommandItem (cmdk Command.Item) row inside CommandPalette. Mention: no Radix primitive; the same listbox option pattern as the palette.

values.when: Command palette. Row 488px wide (x 346 to 834); label 400 13px/19.5px; leading icon 16px at x 355, label at x 378 (measured). Active background oklch(0.6 0.2 255 / 0.1) (measured; see open). Click or Enter runs the command or jump and closes the palette.

Mention autocomplete. Icon fileKindFor(...).icon at 15px, weight 300; attachment name truncated; highlighted row background selection-1; other rows text-content-2. Values from component code (RichTextEditor.tsx:603-628), not measured. Mousedown picks it and inserts an att-chip plus a trailing space (preventDefault keeps editor focus); Enter or Tab also picks.
No trailing element. Row height 30. Used by commands and jump targets (Errands, Reading, Garden, Home, Spring launch) and mention rows.
Trailing HotkeyHint glyph. Row height 32 (measured; not folded to 30). Palette context only.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon name; 16px in palette context, 15px in mention context.

props.name: label
props.description: Row text; runtime data for jump rows; truncates.

props.name: value
props.description: Text the palette filter matches against.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Rendered as HotkeyHint; only with shortcut hotkey.

props.name: active
props.description: Highlighted row, from arrow keys or pointer.

props.name: context
props.description: Sets geometry, highlight token and commit behaviour.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Palette: runs the command or jump, then closes. Mention: inserts the attachment chip and trailing space.

states: active (highlighted; index 0 on palette open; any row reached by pointer or arrow keys)
role: option, with aria-selected true on the active row. The catalogue kind is menu-item; it changes to option because focus stays in a text field (the palette search input or the editor), and the menu focus model does not apply there.
keyboard: ArrowUp and ArrowDown move the active row (handled by the parent list). Enter picks the active row: palette runs and closes; mention inserts. Tab picks in mention context only. Escape closes the list (handled by the parent). Mouse move sets active.
replaces: command palette row, no shortcut (commands and jump targets)
platform: Shortcut glyphs are platform-specific: Control on Windows, Command on macOS (decision). Web: palette shortcuts must not use a combination the browser reserves, because browser shortcuts take precedence; the catalogue gives no key values, so this check cannot be done from it. Desktop: a global hotkey pressed while the main window is focused is handled by the main window. Jump-row labels come from runtime data on both platforms.
open: 1) The palette active row is an accent blue wash oklch(0.6 0.2 255 / 0.1) (measured). Accent blue is reserved for primary action and selection, and a keyboard highlight is neither. Decide: neutral wash-2l (as the menu hover) or accept it as selection. Kept as measured until decided. 2) The palette accent wash and the mention selection-1 token should resolve to one selection token, or be separate by decision. 3) The palette list must scroll; the reference clips rows (see CommandPalette). 4) Shortcut row height 32 kept as measured. 5) Role option instead of the catalogue's menu-item is a change; confirm. 6) Mention values are from component code and not measured. 7) The web shortcut check is blocked: no key values in the catalogue.
